22	// backendManager is the subset of process.Manager the Gateway depends on.
23	type backendManager interface {
24		Addr(name string) (string, bool)
25		Healthy(name string) bool
26	}

28	// Gateway is an HTTP reverse-proxy that routes OpenAI-compatible requests to backends.
29	type Gateway struct {
30		cfg      *config.Config
31		mgr      backendManager
32		log      *slog.Logger
33		rt       *routeTable
34		affinity *affinityTable
35		server   *http.Server

38	// New creates a Gateway backed by the given process manager.
39	// hub may be nil; when non-nil, /monitor and /monitor/ws routes are registered.
40	func New(cfg *config.Config, mgr *process.Manager, hub *monitor.Hub, log *slog.Logger) *Gateway {
41		return newGateway(cfg, mgr, hub, log)
42	}
43	
44	func newGateway(cfg *config.Config, mgr backendManager, hub *monitor.Hub, log *slog.Logger) *Gateway {
45		g := &Gateway{cfg: cfg, mgr: mgr, log: log, rt: buildRouteTable(cfg), affinity: newAffinityTable(cfg.Backends)}
46	
47		mux := http.NewServeMux()
48		mux.HandleFunc("POST /v1/chat/completions", g.handleRoute)
49		mux.HandleFunc("POST /v1/completions", g.handleRoute)
50		mux.HandleFunc("POST /v1/embeddings", g.handleRoute)
51		mux.HandleFunc("POST /v1/rerank", g.handleRoute)
52		mux.HandleFunc("GET /v1/models", g.handleModels)
53		mux.HandleFunc("GET /health", g.handleHealth)
54	
55		if hub != nil {
56			mux.HandleFunc("GET /monitor", monitor.HandlePage)
57			mux.HandleFunc("GET /monitor/ws", monitor.HandleWS(hub))
58		}
59	
60		g.server = &http.Server{Addr: cfg.Listen, Handler: mux}
61		return g
62	}

64	// ListenAndServe starts the HTTP server and shuts it down when ctx is cancelled.
65	func (g *Gateway) ListenAndServe(ctx context.Context) error {
66		errCh := make(chan error, 1)
67		go func() {
68			if err := g.server.ListenAndServe(); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
69				errCh <- err
70			}
71		}()
72		select {
73		case err := <-errCh:
74			return err
75		case <-ctx.Done():
76			shutCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
77			defer cancel()
78			return g.server.Shutdown(shutCtx)
79		}
80	}

82	// handleRoute extracts the model field from the JSON body and proxies to the matching backend.
83	func (g *Gateway) handleRoute(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
84		if len(g.cfg.Backends) == 0 {
85			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "server_error", "no backends configured", "no_backends")
86			return
87		}
88	
89		// Tee the body so the decoder and the upstream both see it.
90		var captured bytes.Buffer
91		tee := io.TeeReader(r.Body, &captured)
92		dec := json.NewDecoder(tee)
93	
94		var payload struct {
95			Model string `json:"model"`
96		}
97		if err := dec.Decode(&payload); err != nil {
98			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request_error", "invalid JSON: "+err.Error(), "bad_request")
99			return
100		}
101		if payload.Model == "" {
102			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request_error", "missing model field", "bad_request")
103			return
104		}
105	
106		// Reconstruct full body: captured bytes (read by decoder) + rest not yet read.
107		r.Body = io.NopCloser(io.MultiReader(&captured, r.Body))
108	
109		backendName, err := g.rt.resolve(payload.Model)
110		if err != nil {
111			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request_error", err.Error(), "model_not_found")
112			return
113		}
114	
115		if !g.mgr.Healthy(backendName) {
116			writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "server_error", "backend unavailable", "backend_unavailable")
117			return
118		}
119	
120		addr, ok := g.mgr.Addr(backendName)
121		if !ok {
122			writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "server_error", "backend unavailable", "backend_unavailable")
123			return
124		}
125	
126		backend := g.cfg.Backends[backendName]
127	
128		// Slot affinity: only applies to managed (llama-server) backends that support id_slot.
129		// Read full body, compute prefix hash, inject id_slot if assigned.
130		// On any error, fall through with the original body unchanged.
131		// TODO: emit EventSlotAffinity to monitor hub once hub supports gateway events.
132		if backend.IsManaged() {
133			if allBody, readErr := io.ReadAll(r.Body); readErr == nil {
134				hash := prefixHash(allBody)
135				if slotID, assigned := g.affinity.Assign(backendName, hash); assigned {
136					allBody = injectSlot(allBody, slotID)
137				}
138				r.Body = io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(allBody))
139				r.ContentLength = int64(len(allBody))
140			}
141		}
142		if backend.Provider == "anthropic" {
143			g.handleAnthropicProxy(w, r, backendName, backend, addr)
144			return
145		}
146	
147		target, parseErr := url.Parse(addr)
148		if parseErr != nil {
149			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "server_error", "invalid backend URL", "internal_error")
150			return
151		}
152	
153		rewriter := g.buildReplacer(backendName)
154	
155		proxy := &httputil.ReverseProxy{
156			Rewrite: func(pr *httputil.ProxyRequest) {
157				pr.SetURL(target)
158				pr.Out.Host = target.Host
159			},
160			FlushInterval: -1,
161			ModifyResponse: func(resp *http.Response) error {
162				if rewriter != nil {
163					resp.Header.Del("Content-Length")
164					resp.ContentLength = -1
165					resp.Body = io.NopCloser(&replacingReader{r: resp.Body, repl: rewriter})
166				}
167				return nil
168			},
169			ErrorHandler: func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request, err error) {
170				g.log.Error("proxy error", "backend", backendName, "error", err)
171				writeError(w, http.StatusBadGateway, "server_error", "upstream error: "+err.Error(), "upstream_error")
172			},
173		}
174	
175		proxy.ServeHTTP(w, r)
176	}
177	
178	// handleAnthropicProxy translates the OpenAI-format request to Anthropic Messages API format,
179	// proxies it directly (without httputil.ReverseProxy), and translates the response back.
180	func (g *Gateway) handleAnthropicProxy(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, backendName string, backend config.Backend, addr string) {
181		body, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
182		if err != nil {
183			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request_error", "failed to read body", "bad_request")
184			return
185		}
186	
187		// Determine whether the client wants a streaming response.
188		var meta struct {
189			Stream bool `json:"stream"`
190		}
191		json.Unmarshal(body, &meta) //nolint:errcheck
192	
193		// model is either the configured model name (managed) or the backend name (external).
194		model := backend.Model
195		if model == "" {
196			model = backendName
197		}
198	
199		antBody, err := anthropic.TranslateRequest(body, model)
200		if err != nil {
201			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request_error", "translation failed: "+err.Error(), "bad_request")
202			return
203		}
204	
205		antURL := strings.TrimRight(addr, "/") + "/v1/messages"
206		antReq, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(r.Context(), http.MethodPost, antURL, bytes.NewReader(antBody))
207		if err != nil {
208			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "server_error", "failed to build upstream request", "internal_error")
209			return
210		}
211		antReq.Header.Set("content-type", "application/json")
212		antReq.Header.Set("x-api-key", backend.APIKey)
213		antReq.Header.Set("anthropic-version", "2023-06-01")
214	
215		resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(antReq)
216		if err != nil {
217			g.log.Error("anthropic upstream error", "backend", backendName, "error", err)
218			writeError(w, http.StatusBadGateway, "server_error", "upstream error: "+err.Error(), "upstream_error")
219			return
220		}
221		defer resp.Body.Close()
222	
223		if resp.StatusCode/100 != 2 {
224			var buf bytes.Buffer
225			buf.ReadFrom(resp.Body) //nolint:errcheck
226			writeError(w, resp.StatusCode, "server_error", "upstream: "+strings.TrimSpace(buf.String()), "upstream_error")
227			return
228		}
229	
230		if meta.Stream {
231			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
232			w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
233			w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
234			anthropic.TranslateStream(resp.Body, w, backendName)
235			return
236		}
237	
238		var buf bytes.Buffer
239		buf.ReadFrom(resp.Body) //nolint:errcheck
240		translated, err := anthropic.TranslateResponse(buf.Bytes(), backendName)
241		if err != nil {
242			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "server_error", "response translation failed: "+err.Error(), "internal_error")
243			return
244		}
245		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
246		w.Write(translated) //nolint:errcheck
247	}
248	
249	// handleModels merges GET /v1/models from all backends and rewrites model IDs to backend names.
250	func (g *Gateway) handleModels(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
251		type modelObj struct {
252			ID      string `json:"id"`
253			Object  string `json:"object"`
254			Created int64  `json:"created"`
255			OwnedBy string `json:"owned_by"`
256		}
257		type modelsResp struct {
258			Object string     `json:"object"`
259			Data   []modelObj `json:"data"`
260		}
261	
262		var (
263			mu   sync.Mutex
264			data []modelObj
265			wg   sync.WaitGroup
266		)
267		now := time.Now().Unix()
268	
269		for name := range g.cfg.Backends {
270			name := name
271			wg.Add(1)
272			go func() {
273				defer wg.Done()
274				fallback := modelObj{ID: name, Object: "model", Created: now, OwnedBy: "wire"}
275	
276				addr, ok := g.mgr.Addr(name)
277				if !ok {
278					mu.Lock()
279					data = append(data, fallback)
280					mu.Unlock()
281					return
282				}
283	
284				ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 5*time.Second)
285				defer cancel()
286	
287				req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, addr+"/v1/models", nil)
288				if err != nil {
289					mu.Lock()
290					data = append(data, fallback)
291					mu.Unlock()
292					return
293				}
294	
295				resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
296				if err != nil {
297					mu.Lock()
298					data = append(data, fallback)
299					mu.Unlock()
300					return
301				}
302				defer resp.Body.Close()
303	
304				var mr modelsResp
305				if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&mr); err != nil || len(mr.Data) == 0 {
306					mu.Lock()
307					data = append(data, fallback)
308					mu.Unlock()
309					return
310				}
311	
312				entry := mr.Data[0]
313				entry.ID = name
314				mu.Lock()
315				data = append(data, entry)
316				mu.Unlock()
317			}()
318		}
319		wg.Wait()
320	
321		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
322		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(modelsResp{Object: "list", Data: data}) //nolint:errcheck
323	}
324	
325	// handleHealth returns 200 if at least one backend is healthy, 503 otherwise.
326	func (g *Gateway) handleHealth(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
327		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
328		for name := range g.cfg.Backends {
329			if g.mgr.Healthy(name) {
330				w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
331				json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"status": "ok"}) //nolint:errcheck
332				return
333			}
334		}
335		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
336		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"status": "degraded"}) //nolint:errcheck
337	}
338	
339	// buildReplacer creates a strings.Replacer that rewrites llama-server model name aliases
340	// in response bodies to the canonical backend name.
341	func (g *Gateway) buildReplacer(backendName string) *strings.Replacer {
342		aliases := g.rt.backendAliases[backendName]
343		var pairs []string
344		for _, alias := range aliases {
345			if alias == backendName {
346				continue
347			}
348			pairs = append(pairs,
349				`"model":"`+alias+`"`, `"model":"`+backendName+`"`,
350			)
351		}
352		if len(pairs) == 0 {
353			return nil
354		}
355		return strings.NewReplacer(pairs...)
356	}
357	
358	// replacingReader wraps an io.Reader and applies a strings.Replacer to each chunk read.
359	// Overflow bytes (when replacement expands the chunk) are buffered internally.
360	type replacingReader struct {
361		r    io.Reader
362		repl *strings.Replacer
363		buf  bytes.Buffer
364	}
365	
366	func (rr *replacingReader) Read(p []byte) (int, error) {
367		if rr.buf.Len() > 0 {
368			return rr.buf.Read(p)
369		}
370		tmp := make([]byte, len(p))
371		n, readErr := rr.r.Read(tmp)
372		if n > 0 {
373			replaced := []byte(rr.repl.Replace(string(tmp[:n])))
374			copy(p, replaced)
375			if len(replaced) > len(p) {
376				rr.buf.Write(replaced[len(p):])
377				return len(p), nil // defer readErr until buf is drained
378			}
379			return len(replaced), readErr
380		}
381		return 0, readErr
382	}
383	
384	// writeError writes an OpenAI-format JSON error response.
385	func writeError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, errType, message, code string) {
386		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
387		w.WriteHeader(status)
388		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{ //nolint:errcheck
389			"error": map[string]any{
390				"message": message,
391				"type":    errType,
392				"code":    code,
393			},
394		})
395	}

42		cmdBuilder func(ctx context.Context, b config.Backend, port int) *exec.Cmd

51	// New creates a Manager. It does not start any processes; call Start.
52	func New(cfg *config.Config, log *slog.Logger) *Manager {
53		m := new(Manager)
54		m.cfg = cfg
55		m.log = log
56		m.procs = make(map[string]*procState)
57		m.eventCh = make(chan monitor.ServerEvent, 256)
58		m.cmdBuilder = func(ctx context.Context, b config.Backend, port int) *exec.Cmd {
59			return exec.CommandContext(ctx, "llama-server", buildArgs(b, port)...)
60		}
61		return m

65	// backends. The channel is buffered (256); sends are non-blocking and events
66	// are dropped when the channel is full.

69	}

71	// Snapshot returns a point-in-time copy of the runtime state of all managed
72	// backends. It acquires read locks and is safe to call concurrently.
73	func (m *Manager) Snapshot() []monitor.BackendStatus {
74		m.mu.RLock()
75		defer m.mu.RUnlock()
76	
77		result := make([]monitor.BackendStatus, 0, len(m.procs))
78		for name, ps := range m.procs {
79			ps.mu.Lock()
80			pid := 0
81			if ps.proc != nil {
82				pid = ps.proc.Pid
83			}
84			status := monitor.BackendStatus{
85				Name:      name,
86				Model:     ps.backend.Model,
87				Port:      ps.port,
88				PID:       pid,
89				Healthy:   ps.healthy,
90				StartedAt: ps.startedAt,
91				Restarts:  ps.restarts,
92			}

99	// Start launches supervisor goroutines for all managed backends.

103		m.cancel = cancel

136		ps, ok := m.procs[name]

138

358	// replacingReader wraps an io.Reader and applies a strings.Replacer to each chunk read.
359	// Overflow bytes (when replacement expands the chunk) are buffered internally.
360	type replacingReader struct {
361		r    io.Reader
362		repl *strings.Replacer
363		buf  bytes.Buffer
364	}
365	
366	func (rr *replacingReader) Read(p []byte) (int, error) {
367		if rr.buf.Len() > 0 {
368			return rr.buf.Read(p)
369		}
370		tmp := make([]byte, len(p))
371		n, readErr := rr.r.Read(tmp)
372		if n > 0 {
373			replaced := []byte(rr.repl.Replace(string(tmp[:n])))
374			copy(p, replaced)
375			if len(replaced) > len(p) {
376				rr.buf.Write(replaced[len(p):])
377				return len(p), nil // defer readErr until buf is drained
378			}
379			return len(replaced), readErr
380		}
381		return 0, readErr
382	}

214	
215		m.mu.RLock()
216		ps := m.procs[name]
217		m.mu.RUnlock()
218	
219		defer func() {

221			ps.healthy = false
222			ps.proc = nil

226		const (

233			attempts    int

236		)

238		for {

241				return

243			}

460	}

464	func waitHealthy(ctx context.Context, port int, timeout time.Duration) error {

466		defer cancel()

475			case <-ctx.Done():

477			case <-ticker.C:
478				resp, err := client.Get(url) //nolint:noctx
479				if err == nil {
480					resp.Body.Close()
481					if resp.StatusCode == http.StatusOK {

483					}
484				}
